regions.merged_text: Many Thanks for your thoughtful kindness, with six crates of fruit that in perfect condition arrived Today. - about which, later. You are fortunate to be in the sunny South-west these days, - rain and snow in a sort of contention and gale from the N.E. urging them on. May the Lord bless your care-taker Johnson and family. I feel that I sort of know them too. Best regards. We pray for them too.
